title: Fun3DU: Functionality Understanding and Segmentation in 3D Scenes
summary: A training-free pipeline that uses language guidance, context-object localization, functional-part segmentation, and multi-view agreement for 3D functionality grounding.

mechanisms.name: Task-conditioned multi-view functional grounding
mechanisms.description: Uses an LLM to identify the relevant context object, segments the functional part in selected views, and consolidates evidence through multi-view agreement.
mechanisms.limitations: Requires suitable views and geometry; published benchmark results do not prove robustness to handheld egocentric video, exact-instance ambiguity, or real-time deployment.
